D: Danny's crew head to Europe to pay back the casino owner they robbed, and run into a rival thief.
P: Serve the snacks when the crew lands in Amsterdam.
S: Crisp fried balls of shredded beef in a thick creamy filling
Beef braised with onion and thyme until it falls apart, shredded into a thick roux-based ragout, chilled overnight, rolled into balls, crumbed and fried at 180C. Grainy mustard.
Bresaola, burrata, chargrilled zucchini, figs, rocket and olives with breadsticks
Bresaola, burrata, figs, grissini and olives on a board, finished with a drizzle of good olive oil and lemon.
M: Saffron risotto finished with butter and parmesan
Carnaroli toasted in butter with onion, white wine, hot stock added ladle by ladle for 18 minutes, saffron steeped in, finished with butter and parmesan.
Rome pork saltimbocca with sage butter
the Rome leg of the job

Pork escalopes pounded thin, pressed with prosciutto and sage, seared crisp in butter and finished with white wine and lemon, over garlicky crushed potatoes. Boil 800g small potatoes for 15 minutes, crush with olive oil, garlic and parsley. Pound 8 pork escalopes thin, lay a slice of prosciutto and a sage leaf on each and secure with a toothpick. Dust the underside with flour. Fry prosciutto side down in 40g butter for 2 minutes, flip for 1 minute. Add 100ml white wine and a squeeze of lemon, bubble, swirl in 20g butter and spoon over.
W: Espresso soaked sponge fingers layered with mascarpone cream

Sponge fingers soaked in strong espresso, layered with light mascarpone and whipped cream, set overnight and finished with a heavy dusting of cocoa. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 80g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip 24 sponge fingers in 300ml cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Chill 4 hours or overnight and dust with cocoa.
the crew's canal-side stop in Amsterdam

Caramel stroopwafels warmed over hot espresso until soft and chewy, served with vanilla ice cream drowned in espresso and a drizzle of salted caramel. Brew 4 hot espressos. Rest a stroopwafel on top of each cup for 2 minutes so the caramel softens. Put a scoop of vanilla ice cream in four small glasses. Warm 3 tbsp thick caramel with a pinch of sea salt. Pour an espresso over each scoop, drizzle with caramel and serve with two warm stroopwafels each.
K: Bitter orange aperitivo, prosecco and soda over ice with an orange slice
60ml orange bitter aperitivo, 90ml prosecco and a splash of soda over ice with an orange slice.

s.note: Crisp fried balls of shredded beef in a thick creamy filling
s.how: Braise 500g beef chuck with an onion and thyme until it falls apart, then shred. Cook 50g butter with 50g flour, add 300ml of the stock and the beef and chill overnight. Roll into balls, crumb in egg and panko and fry at 180C. Serve with grainy mustard.

s.note: Bresaola, burrata, chargrilled zucchini, figs, rocket and olives with breadsticks
s.how: Brush the zucchini with a little of the oil, salt it and chargrill until striped and tender. Lay the bresaola on a board with the burrata, halved figs, breadsticks and olives. Drizzle with good olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

m.note: Saffron risotto finished with butter and parmesan
m.how: Soften an onion in 30g butter, add 350g carnaroli and toast. Add 125ml white wine, then 1.2L hot stock ladle by ladle for 18 minutes, with a pinch of saffron steeped in. Finish with 40g butter and 60g parmesan.

w.note: Espresso soaked sponge fingers layered with mascarpone cream
w.how: Whisk 3 egg yolks with 80g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip 24 sponge fingers in 300ml cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Chill 4 hours or overnight and dust with cocoa.

d.note: Bitter orange aperitivo, prosecco and soda over ice with an orange slice
d.how: For each drink, fill a big wine glass with ice. Add 60ml orange bitter aperitivo, 90ml prosecco and a splash of soda water. Add an orange slice. Makes four.
